title: To Be the Shining Cullinan in the Rough

text_block_list.text:
Royce and Royce invited me to watch race today.
Trainer contract still up in air.
choice_data_list: So, why'd you invite me today?
So, why'd you invite me today?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: We can talk later, okay? Look! Satsuki Sho about to start!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Top favorite today——
Tokai Teio!
Carrying flawless four-win streak!
First jewel of Triple Crown, battle of generation's best——Satsuki Sho. Every eye locked on Tokai Teio, cruising in top form.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Starting from crowded outer gate puts Teio-san at huge disadvantage. What will her angle be?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Heheh, crowded inside? Fine, I'll take wide open outside instead! Disadvantage? Longer path? Whatever!——

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Doesn't matter to me!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Tokai Teio! Tokai Teio out front!
Incredible! Tokai Teio takes the win!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Teio-san's raw talent completely dismantles that disadvantage… True genius in action.
choice_data_list: Wait, was the racer you met as a kid…
Wait, was the racer you met as a kid…

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Yes. That's her.

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
Five straight wins… Just like Symboli Rudolf!
Teio might really become greatest of all time!

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Started furthest outside and made it look effortless! Unreal talent!
Can't wait to see how high her streak goes!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Haha, just like always… Crowd sees Teio-san race, sings praises, compares her to legendary greats.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Whenever debate on "strongest Umamusume" begins…
Always becomes fight over who reigns absolute.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Five GI crowns including Triple Crown? Or unbroken record of 11 wins in 11 starts?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Symboli Rudolf-san? Or Maruzensky-san?
Either way, both hailed as "the greatest".
Which means——

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
There is no single "greatest".
Could be "greatest closer", "greatest stayer".
…Many forms of greatness.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Then logically…
…Must be a "greatest" meant for me.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Strength alone does not make legend.
Greatness requires two pillars——
Record of wins, and captivating drama that grips hearts.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
——First crown secured!
Next stop: Triple Crown!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Teio can seize both using raw talent alone.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
I lack that inherent gift.
So I manufacture drama with sheer intellect!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Through fine art of self-production!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
What I lack in victories, I make up in narrative impact!
I'll leverage every trick so nobody forgets me!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
If I'm racing… If I'm alive…!
Naturally I want to become legendary Umamusume!

Tug in chest whenever looking at her. Couldn't look away.
Now understood why——

text_block_list.name: Mid-Career Trainer
text_block_list.text: Hey, had solid marks at trainer academy! Trainer <username>, got clear goal?
choice_data_list: Uhh… Maybe just one win to start.

text_block_list.text: Knew my limits. Cheap flattery wouldn't delude me. Still, deep urge lingered: refused to end up mere nobody.
Not unique feeling. Most swallow ambition to maintain face. But not her…

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
There it is. My ambition. Who I am.
…Verdict?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Scout racer born with everything?
…Or scout racer clawing toward greatness knowing full well she lacks natural genius?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Tell me. Who do you pick?

Longed for spotlight, unashamed.
Betting everything on self-production strategy.

Pride and appearances meant zero to her.
Struck core of my heart…
Felt exact same way.
choice_data_list: I… I want to help find your "greatest"!
I… I want to help find your "greatest"!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Trainer. Recall what I said?
Greatness needs record and narrative drama.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Buzz. Spectacle.
DRAMA.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: …Clear?

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: So sorry! Crowd was sooo noisy, couldn't hear! Say that again, pretty please?♪
choice_data_list: (She wants me to do a retake!?)

text_block_list.text: Chasing greatness required non-stop self-production. Rehearsal for official Twinkle Series debut, then…
choice_data_list: I promise to make you THE GREATEST!
I promise to make you THE GREATEST!

text_block_list.text: She could pull it off. Using strategy, production, social reach, carving path to legend.

If Royce and Royce achieved greatness——
She'd become beacon of hope for racers just like her.
Proof that lack of innate genius doesn't kill dreams. Proof anyone determined enough can seize highest throne.
choice_data_list: Please, let me help fulfill your dream!
Please, let me help fulfill your dream!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text: Trainer…!

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Yes… If you truly want me.
Overjoyed to work together…!

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
"Hear that…? Scout offer on spot?"
"Congrats! Caught front row seat to real moment!"
Spectators burst into cheers and applause. Guaranteed to spark talk…

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Passion came through, but delivery: mediocre. Lines lacked punch.
We'll polish that in rehearsal.

text_block_list.name: Royce and Royce
text_block_list.text:
Partners now, sink or swim.
Got your work cut out for you, Trainer.
